images.caption: In 2017 I took pictures in this area to the north of Tarlabaşı Boulevard. It was clear that there were building activities that would change the neighbourhood considerably. Lots of empty buildings, lots of run down buildings, streets that were split by corrugated iron fences, behind which large buildings were being created. People holding on to their neighbourhood, newcomers finding cheap places. I was astounded to find that in 2023 so little had changed. Some pictures are taken from almost the same spot, others are taken during my ramble through streets I knew or did not know.
